beats.lead: You did it today without thinking
beats.text: Someone had to invent cut and paste.
beats.note: Before it existed, moving text meant retyping it, or physically cutting paper and pasting it down. The names are literal.

beats.name: Larry Tesler
beats.role: Worked on a text editor at Xerox PARC built around the idea that the same keystroke should always do the same thing, no hidden modes to remember.

beats.text: He spent a career removing modes.
